source_definitions.global_grf: Global X/Z depend on participant orientation; they are not automatically anatomical anterior/lateral.
source_definitions.insole: Separate virtual-insole signals are transformed into the foot frame.
source_definitions.cop: Published insole AP position is relative to the back of the calcaneus; this does not establish an ankle-origin COP.
source_definitions.joint_plot_signs: Figure 5 uses extension-positive hip/knee and plantarflexion-positive ankle; tracing plotting transformations to raw OpenSim columns is required before changing raw-column signs.

confirmed_converter_behavior.behavior: ForceX/ForceZ are normalized and directly assigned anterior/lateral labels without participant-heading rotation.

required_correction.preserve: Keep the values and missingness under explicit source global X/Z labels, with BW units unchanged.
required_correction.canonical: Withhold anatomical horizontal channels unless the required frame transformation is independently established.
required_correction.scope: Both time and phase outputs and both reference sides; all unrelated fields must be exactly preserved.
required_correction.execution: New isolated correction only; frozen queued code unchanged.
